# Introduction

Teams continue working on their final projects, moving from project planning toward analysis and results.

# Learning goals

1. Continue analyzing project data

2. Apply appropriate data science methods

3. Interpret preliminary results

4. Refine the project based on feedback

# Lecture - Final Project Work

Guidance and support for ongoing project development.

# Lab - Final Project Work

Team-based analysis, coding, visualization, and troubleshooting.

# Discussion - Project Check-in

Teams share progress and discuss challenges and next steps.

# Assignment

Submit a project progress update and maintain organized project files and commits.
